purpose: A curated directory for comparing reporting, institutional positions and authored analysis about Syria.
editorial_policy: Publisher self-descriptions are attributed, not certifications of neutrality or accuracy.
Strengths and limits are editorial reading guidance, not reliability scores.
No political affiliation is inferred from geography, language, access or an article's subjects.
Distinguish an official statement, independently reported event and analyst judgment.
These are source entities, not a representative sample of Syrian opinion.
Only successfully parsed RSS endpoints appear in feeds. Endpoint verification does not mean continuous collection or republishing rights.
verification_notes: Public publisher About pages or institutional profiles supplied identity, mission and disclosed ownership context.
Where direct retrieval was blocked, evidence records explicitly say indexed_primary. Public organizational identity is corroborated separately where available.
No full articles, private source dumps, user comments or social-media posts are included.
The independently checked public directory is not a claim that any private research system currently ingests these entities.
coverage_note: 28 selected entities, including two additional UN publishing bodies and two monitoring/advocacy organizations. A directory entry does not establish a live connection. Six selected institutional relationships are separately documented in relationships.json.
